intro.explanation: Sensors provide inputs; the program decides; motors act.

kit.q: How many IR modules are in one kit?
kit.explanation: The shared kit has three; line mode uses only two.

options: To supply switched motor current and direction
basics.explanation: GPIO cannot directly provide the motor current. The driver switches the motor supply.

software.q: Which setup matches these robot sketches?
options: Any BLE board with no USB
Original ESP32 Dev Module, core 3.x, 115200 monitor
software.explanation: Select the actual original WROOM-32 target and USB port. The code uses core 3.x LEDC APIs.

cpp.q: Why use millis() in the remote loop?
options: It measures elapsed time without a long blocking wait
cpp.explanation: The program can keep checking stop commands and its timeout.

assembly.q: When should sensor mounts be moved?
options: With power off and USB unplugged
Only after removing the microcontroller chip
assembly.explanation: Turn off supplies before mechanical changes and keep wires clear of wheels.

options: It is always the same jumper as ENA
It controls the module regulator arrangement, not motor PWM
wiring.explanation: Check the exact module. Motor ENA/ENB jumpers are separate from the regulator jumper.

serial.q: For the PING test, what should you select?
serial.explanation: The teaching sketch reads up to newline and replies PONG to PING.

remote.q: What happens if movement commands stop arriving?
remote.explanation: The deadman stops motion when no valid movement command arrives for 800 ms.

line.q: With sensors flanking the line, both white can mean…
line.explanation: Two digital sensors cannot distinguish these positions. The sketch uses a conservative bounded search.

obstacle.q: Front blocked and both sides clear: choose…
obstacle.explanation: This workshop specifies left preference when both sides are clear.

calibration.q: What should you change during a comparison test?
calibration.explanation: One change makes it easier to connect an observation to its cause.

troubleshooting.q: Paired Bluetooth but no serial connection: first check…
options: Outgoing Classic SPP COM port and terminal ownership
troubleshooting.explanation: Pairing is not proof of a usable serial COM port. USB remains a fallback.

challenges.q: After changing a program, what is the best next step?
options: Predict the result, test with supervision, log observations
challenges.explanation: Compare expected and observed behavior and keep the original version.

faq.q: Does the workshop certificate confer official accreditation?
faq.explanation: It is a record of this course and its configured learning requirements.

final.q: Which GPIO may receive a 5 V sensor output directly?
final.explanation: ESP32 GPIO requires compatible 3.3 V signals.

final.q: Which jumper is removed for left PWM?
final.explanation: ENA is motor enable; regulator 5V-EN has a different job.

final.q: Which communication method is the wireless assumption?
final.explanation: Classic SPP uses a supported Windows serial port, not a browser controller.

final.q: Both sensors white in the line layout means…
final.explanation: The layout has an ambiguity and the program bounds its search.

final.q: All three obstacle directions blocked leads to…
final.explanation: The reverse area needs supervision because there is no rear sensor.

options: Source built for the selected target
final.explanation: Compilation does not verify actual wiring or physical behavior.
It records the configured workshop learning requirements only.
